# Fixture provenance

CyanCove authored these three original short studies on 2026-09-10 specifically
for this repository. They contain no copied lyrics, arrangement, or third-party
composition. Permission: use, modify, test and redistribute with this project.
The .crd files are actual format inputs, not production-generated expectations.
`cases.json` was hand-transcribed before writing the production decoder.

Syntax authority: https://www.chordpro.org/chordpro/directives-env_grid/ and its
linked title/time/tempo directives, retrieved 2026-09-10. Changes' explicit
quarter-cell interpretation is a separate import choice, not a ChordPro timing

reference-tool and independent-user compatibility acceptance remains open.
